title: ODA MLeader root framing and cross-peer evidence reconciliation
mode: Primary format specification review with current open-source issue/commit crosswalk
scope: Resolve whether embedded MLeader root connection/direction coordinates are conditional on flags 290/291 under the ODA v5.4.1 profile.
Refresh cross-peer evidence boundaries for LibreDWG string and CMC issues, ACadSharp whole-file MTEXT and SPLINE reports, and ezdxf ACIS limits.
Turn the resolved ODA-profile question into a fast local implementation subplan while preserving standalone object-context and 3D qualification boundaries.

method.limitations: ODA documents the field sequence and notes that it writes both root flags true; generated false-flag vectors are conformance controls for the specified unconditional field sequence, not producer-authored compatibility evidence. GitHub issues are mutable reporter/maintainer records. The linked LibreDWG commits were inspected but no released package was checked for inclusion. ACadSharp issue reports and ezdxf documentation are not independent AutoCAD or ACIS-kernel runs.

sources.observed: §20.4.86 lists B290, B291, 3BD10 connection point, and 3BD11 direction in sequence without conditional guards. The table labels the flags but does not make either coordinate conditional; ODA notes it writes both flags true. This resolves the ODA-profile embedded MLeader field order, not producer-specific variants or standalone object-context graph serialization.

#1412 remains listed open while linking commits for actual-buffer termination and zero-length group emission; commit notes distinguish the reachable heap-tail defect from the latent/unreachable state and do not identify a released package. #1414 remains an unresolved peer TV/TU escape-policy question. #1415 reports palette reverse-lookup loss of distinct stored ACI indices. These are peer shapes, not local libdxfrw findings or normative contracts.

#1277 concerns standalone MLeader context objects and does not make the embedded entity body interchangeable with the standalone context preamble/scale/owner graph. #1297 reports whole-file AC1032 AutoCAD rejection with an MTEXT flag shape even though the object reportedly matches a native-saved object; missing style objects remain an unproven hypothesis. #1299 reports a DWG-to-DXF SPLINE that GDAL rejects but provides no exact curve arrays or independent expected curve in the issue body.

The current documentation describes a limited ACIS entity count, says unsupported entities load as NONE_ENTITY with data lost, and warns arbitrary ACIS data cannot be loaded and re-exported. Its generation APIs can create test carriers but do not qualify arbitrary ACIS semantics.

The current embedded parser and writer conditionally consume/emit the connection and direction 3BDs based on flags 290/291. The plan now calls for a symmetric ODA-profile correction and four generated flag-pair controls with cursor and suffix sentinels.

plan_impact.existing_owner_refinement: Resolve the embedded MLeader root field-order question under ODA §20.4.86 and make it the next local PAR-20/7F.1 behavior-bearing slice. Preserve the separate fail-closed standalone OBJECTCONTEXTDATA graph gate, and reuse existing ASCII string, CMC, spline, and whole-file acceptance owners.

repository_state: Only the plan and research receipt were edited in the existing broadly dirty shared worktree. No files were staged or committed.
